maintenance_led.reason: Mostly new installations: data center, residential and commercial electrical systems, plus custom power equipment; maintenance is smaller.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are private: data centers, homebuilders, commercial and industrial facilities; government work is minor.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly organically across segments, with occasional acquisitions such as DBM Global structural steel.

mission_critical.reason: Electrical contracting is bid project by project, so customers switch contractors easily; custom power gear is niche.

notes: Segments mix project contracting with custom power products; the mission-critical answer is a judgement call.
